grammarFocus: because / so；should；比较级与最高级入门。
title: Healthy Habits and Rest: A Talk with Mia
instructions: 听录音，完成10个问题。录音会播放两遍。第一遍听大意，第二遍听细节。答案必须来自录音原文。所有题目为单选题或填空题。填空题答案必须与录音中的原词完全一致，且不超过字数限制。本材料为模拟教学材料，不是官方雅思考试。
transcript:
Leo: Hi Mia. You look tired. Are you OK?
Mia: Hi Leo. Yes, I'm fine. But I'm a little tired. I went to bed late last night.
Leo: Why? Did you watch a film?
Mia: No, I studied for a test. I went to bed at one o'clock.
Leo: One o'clock! That's very late. You should go to bed earlier. Sleep is important.
Mia: I know. But I have a lot of homework. I'm busy.
Leo: I'm busy too. But I always sleep for eight hours. I feel good in the morning.
Mia: Eight hours? That's a lot. I usually sleep for six hours.
Leo: Six hours is not enough. You should sleep for seven or eight hours. Then you can think better.
Mia: Maybe you're right. But I also drink a lot of coffee. Coffee helps me stay awake.
Leo: How many cups do you drink?
Mia: I drink about four cups a day.
Leo: Four cups! That's too much. You should drink less coffee. And you should drink more water.
Mia: How much water?
Leo: About eight glasses a day. Water is better for you than coffee.
Mia: OK. I can try. What about food? What should I eat?
Leo: You should eat vegetables and fruit every day. They are good for your health. And you should eat less sugar.
Mia: I like sweet food. But I can eat an apple instead of a cake.
Leo: Good idea. Also, you should exercise. I run every morning. Running is good for you.
Mia: I don't like running. I like swimming. Is swimming OK?
Leo: Yes, swimming is great. It's good exercise. You should swim two or three times a week.
Mia: OK. I can swim on Tuesday and Thursday. And I can go to bed before eleven.
Leo: That's a good plan. You will feel better soon.
Mia: Thanks, Leo. You are a good friend.

grammar.title: because / so；should；比较级与最高级入门
grammar.explanation: because表示原因，so表示结果。should表示建议，意思是“应该”。比较级用于两者比较，如better（更好）；最高级用于三者或以上比较，如best（最好）。
grammar.example: Water is better for you than coffee.

options: I am tired because I went to bed late.
I am tired so I went to bed late.
I am tired because so I went to bed late.
answers: I am tired because I went to bed late.
questions.explanation: because引导原因，表示“因为”，所以选A。
questions.evidence: Mia: I'm a little tired. I went to bed late last night.

questions.explanation: should后面直接跟动词原形，所以选B。
questions.evidence: Leo: You should go to bed earlier.

options: Water is more good than coffee.
questions.evidence: Leo: Water is better for you than coffee.

options: Swimming is the best exercise for me.
